name: memory
description: Python MCP memory server: promote facts to long-term memory, list/review memories, manage profile memory files, and persist channel summaries (save_summary).

config_schema.label: Database URL
config_schema.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for memory storage

config_schema.label: OMNI_DIR
config_schema.description: Data directory for wiki memory files

config_schema.label: Default profile
config_schema.description: Profile used when a tool call carries no _meta.profile_name. Empty = refuse the call instead of inventing a profile directory (never the literal 'default').
